newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch April manufacturing sales rise 12 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch April manufacturing sales rise 12 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch April manufacturing sales were some 12 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.

The CBS manufacturing sales figures refer to the guilder value of manufacturers' sales and are usually published one to two weeks before manufacturing production figures which show the rise or fall in volume terms.
The CBS said the increase in April 1997 compared to the same month a year earlier was the strongest rise since May 1995.
It added the rise was stimulated by a two percent increase in sale prices and the fact that April 1997 had one more working day than April 1996.
The sector with the strongest year-on-year increase in sales was the metal industry, CBS said.
